methodology.latency: Application publication to callback, simulation-clock milliseconds; delivered samples only.
methodology.throughput: Unique receipt body bytes in fixed interior callback-time interval, decimal MB/s; excludes drain.
methodology.units: Body MB/s excludes ROS serialization, RTPS and transport headers.
limitations: One window per implementation; no confidence-based tail conclusion or capacity estimate.
KVM results include full payload verification and are not detailed-CPU performance results.
No supplemental bulk workload was run in these qualification cases.
No missing published-cohort samples does not prove all scheduled releases were published.
READY binary is pinned; exact correspondence to retained source snapshot is unverified.
Functional m5 payload copying changes the modeled memory-cost contract relative to timed DMA.
